verdict.rationale: AnyDesk is a remote-desktop tool, not an AI agent or LLM host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from MCP servers is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any AI assistant or MCP client capability that would make this axis apply. Its CLI and REST API are automation surfaces, not MCP tool consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
